command: set -euo pipefail; echo '--- ADB DEVICES ---'; adb devices -l; serial=$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1; exit}'); test -n "$serial"; echo ADB_SERIAL=$serial; echo MODEL=$(adb -s "$serial" shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r'); echo MANUFACTURER=$(adb -s "$serial" shell getprop ro.product.manufacturer | tr -d '\r'); echo ANDROID=$(adb -s "$serial" shell getprop ro.build.version.release | tr -d '\r'); echo SDK=$(adb -s "$serial" shell getprop ro.build.version.sdk | tr -d '\r'); echo '--- BLUEEYE PACKAGES ---'; adb -s "$serial" shell pm list packages | tr -d '\r' | grep -Ei 'blueeye|tracker' || true; echo '--- TOP ACTIVITY ---'; adb -s "$serial" shell dumpsys activity activities | grep -m1 'mResumedActivity' || true
